meta.title: Pengrim — Football Advertising & Pitchside Brand Visibility
meta.description: Pengrim connects brands with LED perimeter boards, in-stadium inventory and live broadcast visibility at football matches. We run the whole process — from match and league selection to reporting — end to end.
